item.title: Neutron capture experiment sheds light on ancient stardust
item.description: Niobium-94, an isotope of niobium with 41 protons and 53 neutrons, is a critical crossroads in the complex nuclear processes that forge heavy elements under the intense pressures and temperatures of dying stars.
